mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies near the Verona Public Library today with the moon in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is celebrating the Week Without Driving through October 8th, encouraging residents to explore transportation beyond a personal vehicle. Additionally, the Plan Commission has a meeting on October 5th to discuss several development projects, including updates for South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in our community. Join in for trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or test your knowledge at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on Wednesday, September 24, an 11-year-old child was involved in a collision with a vehicle while riding a bicycle, but thankfully, they did not require hospital transport.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The restaurant will be opening its doors today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
